key: Sine and Cosine HDL optimized block
title: Cosine HDL Optimized
text: Implement fixed-point sine and cosine wave by using lookup table approach optimized for HDL code generation, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Output formula} sets Select the signal(s) to output cos(2*pi*u); {Number of data points} sets the number of data points to retrieve from the lookup, {Table data type} sets the table data type fixdt, {Data type assistant} selects the mode of data type specification Fixed and {Simulate RAM Delay} sets the insert a unit delay. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: Input signal to implement sine or cosine wave real-valued signal

ports.name: sin(2*pi*u)
ports.summary: Fixed-point sine wave real-valued fixed-point signal

ports.name: cos(2*pi*u)
ports.summary: Fixed-point cosine wave real-valued fixed-point signal

params.name: Output formula
params.values: Select the signal(s) to output cos(2*pi*u) | sin(2*pi*u) | exp(j*2*pi*u) | sin(2*pi*u) and cos(2*pi*u)

params.name: Number of data points
params.values: Specify the number of data points to retrieve from the lookup table 64 (default) | integer, greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Table data type
params.values: Specify the table data type fixdt(0,16,15) (default) | fixed point expression

params.name: Data type assistant
params.values: Select the mode of data type specification Fixed point (default) | Expression

params.name: Simulate RAM Delay
params.values: Insert a unit delay off (default) | on
